title: Erucic acid in feed and food
authors: EFSA Panel on Contaminants in the Food Chain (CONTAM), Knutsen HK, Alexander J, Barregård L, Bignami M, Brüschweiler B, et al.
funder: European Food Safety Authority, on request from the European Commission (Question number EFSA-Q-2015-00027).
result: Natural forms of rapeseed usually contain more than 40% erucic acid; cultivars bred since the 1970s contain less than 1%, current varieties usually less than 0.5%. Canola denotes Brassica cultivars whose oil contains less than 2% erucic acid and whose meal is low in glucosinolates. Tolerable daily intake 7 mg/kg body weight per day, from a NOAEL of 0.7 g/kg bw per day for myocardial lipidosis in young rats and newborn piglets.
